types.description: ET 200S 4DI NAMUR electronic module; partial assembled eight-clamp field interface

modelingNotes: Assembled field-interface abstraction on separately ordered TM-E15S24-01, TM-E15C24-01 or TM-E15N24-01, per manual p.8. The electronic card alone does not own the base clamps. Installed terminal module is not established.

Manufacturer assignment p.7: 1=DI0, 5=DI1, 2=DI2, 6=DI3; 3/4/7/8=Vs. Figure 1-1 p.14 explicitly joins 3/4/7/8: represent with explicit project jumpers 3-4, 3-7, 3-8. Metadata never joins nets. Never jumper an input to Vs or another input.

All field connections are application-dependent. Backplane and P1/P2 supply interfaces are needed for operation but their individual contacts and polarity are not enumerated. BACKPLANE and POWER are authoring aliases, not manufacturer connector markings.

A3/A4/A7/A8 AUX1 facilities belong to other terminal-base arrangements (p.7–8); none is present on selected 24-01 arrangement. No PE, bond or shield field terminal is established for this abstraction.

Siemens datasheet 09/29/2017, modified 09/21/2017, pp.1–3, distributor mirror https://www.nexinstrument.com/assets/images/28092017-siemens/pdf/12.pdf : module supply nominal 24 VDC, permissible 20.4–28.8 VDC; one sensor supply rated 45 mA, minimum 8.2 V loaded. No per-clamp 45 mA capability or 24 V input is implied.

Manual pp.15–16: NAMUR signal 0 is 0.35–1.2 mA; signal 1 is 2.1–7 mA. Sensor supply electronically short-circuit protected; additional redundant supply prohibited. Conditional values kept in notes, not scalar terminal ratings.

Manual p.15 input delay 4.6 ms differs from mirrored datasheet p.2 4.6 microseconds; manual two-byte address space differs from datasheet four packed bits/one unpacked byte. Unresolved; timing and process-image behavior not modeled.
Single-terminal input channels and sensor-supply bus endpoints provide circuit rendering only; no converter simulation, diagnostic behavior or automatic internal continuity.

connectionCoverage.notes: Eight field clamps of documented 24-01 terminal-base arrangement covered. Separate base is not included in electronic-card order. Backplane and P1/P2 supply contacts remain unenumerated; represented only as unpinned interface metadata. AUX1 belongs to other base variants, not this arrangement. Installed base unknown.

BACKPLANE.description: Manual Figure 1-1; individual contacts not enumerated. Key is an authoring alias.

POWER.description: Manual Figure 1-1 collective P1/P2 label; individual contact positions and polarity not established. Key is an authoring alias.
